title: Worker scope check ignores git-ignored .krn/tmp caches
body:
Outcome: worker start does not report git-ignored cache files as scope violations. In t-xqp3agn the worker turn exited 3 listing only .krn/tmp/node-compile-cache/** (ignored by .gitignore .krn/), which the worker's node runs created inside the worktree.
Proof: an observer runs a fake worker turn that writes .krn/tmp/x in the worktree and asserts exit is not 3.
